summary.result: Results of this experimental study showed that the flexural strength of unnotched steel fiber-reinforced lightweight polymer concrete increased from 8.61 to 13.96 MPa when mixing ratio of fiber content increased from 0 to 1.5%.
summary.background: Stress intensity factors( $K_{IC}$ ) increased with increasing fiber content ratio while it did not increase with increasing notch ratio.
summary.method: Energy release rate ( $G_{IC}$ ) turned out to depend upon the notch size, and it increased with increasing steel fiber content.

summary_ko.method: 에너지 방출률($G_{IC}$)은 오목부 크기에 따라 의존하며, 강섬유 함량이 증가함에 따라 증가하였다.
